0022600126.text: The Utah Jazz (1-2, 11th in the West, 5th in the Northwest and 2 games back) host the Memphis Grizzlies (3-0, 2nd in the Southwest and 5th in the West), who enter on a three-game winning streak. Utah is without Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain) and Trey Alexander (knee bruise), and Jaxson Hayes (shoulder soreness) is day-to-day and a game-time decision, while Memphis has Isaiah Stewart (ankle) and Karim Lopez (knee bruise) listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions. The teams split 2-2 in the 2025-26 season, and the Jazz trail 0-1 in the 2026-27 season series after a 123-103 loss in Memphis on October 21.
